newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says outsourcing deal finalised.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says outsourcing deal finalised.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Tuesday it signed a final agreement with SCI Systems, Inc and Solectron Corporation to turn over its printed board activities to them.

"SCI and Solectron will gradually take over a large part of the global printed board assembly activities related to the AXE switching system and certain access products within Ericsson's business area Infocom Systems," Ericsson said in a statement.
The deals would increase the group's competitiveness and give them the opportunity to rationalise further, it said.

Ericsson said SCI would take over an Ericsson printed board assembly operation in Spain and its 350 or so employees. Similarly, Selectron intends to take over a printed board assembly operation in Brazil which also has 350 employees.
The deals are in line with Ericsson Infocom Systems' plans to outsource activities.
Solectron will set up a centre in Stockholm and Norrkoping, Sweden where it will employ about 65 people, Ericsson said.
